personality_one_liner: A professional, warm, and highly readable coaching tracker that brings academic rigor and structure into a seamless iOS-native flow.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to screen edge; use md or lg margin. Content flows comfortably.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar.
Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling content.
Apply to featured action buttons and Floating Action Buttons.
dont's: Never blur body text regions or form fields.
Do not use glass for standard list items or cards.

screens.name: Student Dashboard
screens.purpose: A personalized home screen combining welcome messaging, top-level progress stats, and immediate access to their current action item.

states.empty: Illustration with 'Commencez votre premier module' and CTA to view courses.
states.error: Readable error message 'Impossible de charger le tableau de bord' with a retry button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Bonjour [Nom]' and avatar. Top section: visual progress indicator (bar chart or circle) + 'jours restants'. Middle: 'Reprendre où vous en étiez' featured card with glass overlay on the course image. Bottom: Sticky CTA 'Déposer ma preuve d'avancement' pinned above tab bar.

screens.name: Course List (Espace Étudiant)
screens.purpose: A structured, filterable list of all curriculum modules allowing students to find what to study next.

states.loading: Skeleton rows matching the height of course cards.
states.empty: No courses found for the selected filter. 'Aucun cours dans cette catégorie'.

screens.layout: Sticky header with horizontal scrollable filter chips (pill shape, surfaceTertiary/brandTertiary based on active state: Tous, YouTube, PDF, Externe). Below: Masonry or single-column cards with status chips (À faire, En cours, Terminé) using brandTertiary/warning/success colors.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard / List
screens.purpose: Command center for coaches to monitor cohorts, filter by status, and quickly spot students falling behind.

states.empty: No students match the current filters.
states.error: Unable to load student data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Top sticky bar with Cohort segmented controls (tabs) and a Filter icon. Search bar underneath. Main list: Compact student rows (Avatar, Name, Progress %) with a highly visible red 'En retard' badge if they haven't submitted proof in 7+ days. Swiping a row or tapping an overflow menu reveals the quick WhatsApp action.

screens.name: Student Detail (Admin)
screens.purpose: Detailed view of an individual student's progression with coach actions and alerts.
screens.layout: Profile cover banner (brand tint) overlapping the student's avatar. Top card: General info and cohort. Middle section: Recharts component showing progress curve. Alert banner (warning/error colored) for 'Étudiant en retard'. Sticky bottom action bar with two buttons: 'Relance WhatsApp' (primary) and 'PDF Bilan' (secondary).

student_hero.alt: Young African student studying online with a laptop and headphones

coach_office.alt: Professional business coach in a session

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the #8A1C2B (Bordeaux) primary color for branding, utilizing the generated tonal palette for active states, chips, and backgrounds.
Implement the sticky primary CTA pattern (e.g., 'Déposer ma preuve d'avancement') floating above the scrollable content with a bottom padding buffer.
Ensure the application language is French ('Déposer ma preuve d'avancement', 'En retard', etc.).
For the 'En retard' alert on the admin side, emphasize it using the error token (#C62828) applied to a surface/badge to ensure high visibility.
Use Recharts for the admin progress chart; configure it to be compact and mobile-friendly without breaking the safe area margins.
Never use Indigo, Blue, or Purple. Stick strictly to the warm gray/off-white neutrals and the Bordeaux brand colors.
Use expo-image with a gradient scrim (top to bottom, transparent to surfaceInverse at 70% opacity) for any text overlaid on images, like the 'Reprendre où vous en étiez' card.
